Fixed in 8a3b3e6/299feb9 — the streaming fail-closed charge is now gated on delivered content (`delivered=agg_output_chars > 0`), so an empty stream with no usage settles at ~0 exactly like the blocking twin. Pinned by `test_budgeted_empty_stream_without_usage_settles_zero`.

Fixed in 0aa9999 — a catalog entry priced 0.0 in and 0.0 out is a known-free model, so its cost is zero however the stream ended. The missing-usage arm consulted neither the catalog nor `_orca_meta` before charging `cap - spent`. Pinned by `test_budgeted_free_model_without_usage_is_not_fails_closed`.

Fixed in 0aa9999 — the blocking retry loop now pins the request-log primary key (`log_values.setdefault("id", ...)`), mirroring the streaming path, so an ack-loss retry whose probe cannot yet see the first attempt's row collides on the key instead of inserting a second row and charging twice. Pinned by `test_budgeted_blocking_retry_cannot_double_charge_a_blind_row`.

Fixed in efe4af4 — the streaming unmeasured arm now skips the fail-closed raise when the row (or the usage frame) already carries an authoritative cost, mirroring the blocking guard. A frame with `cost_usd` and no token keys is measured, not unmeasured. Pinned by `test_budgeted_stream_priced_usage_keeps_its_cost`.

Fixed in 1052eaa — countable-but-unpriceable usage is now charged on a fault ending too, priced from what the stream delivered. The arm required `stream_ending == _STREAM_COMPLETED`, so a stream that faulted after such a frame matched neither arm and settled at the row's zero cost. Pinned by `test_budgeted_stream_fault_with_unpriceable_usage_is_charged`.

Fixed in 1052eaa — that arm is now gated on `usage_requested`, so a client that explicitly declined usage frames is priced from the delivery instead of charged the whole remaining allowance. Pinned by `test_budgeted_stream_unpriceable_usage_honors_usage_opt_out`.
